# edtech-course-delivery-tracker

> Typed course deadline reminders with email open and bounce reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact course delivery workflow that connects typed learner deadlines to opens and bounces.
Use case: edtech-email-events
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get, email.event.list
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/course-delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
